name: threejs
description: Ten grounded skills for three.js (r185 / three@0.185.1): scene/canvas setup, 3D-on-web-pages, glTF/OBJ loading, materials/lighting/shadows, performance/instancing, interaction/picking, animation, post-processing/render targets, debugging, and WebGPU/TSL migration.
